We also point out that Law No 200/2010 on the regime of foreigners in the Republic of Moldova defines a "frontier worker" as a citizen of a state sharing a border with the Republic of Moldova, employed in localities in the border zone on Moldovan territory, who returns daily or at least once a week to the territory of the state where he or she has permanent residence and of which he or she is a citizen.

In particular, we recommend examining the notion of "frontier worker" as worded in Law No 209/2020 of Romania on certain measures for crossing the state border of Romania and facilitating border crossing by frontier workers.
